title: Violinist Herbert Lindsay and his double stops
summary: Lindsay was a crackerjack violinist who played double stops, and worked in all the downtown bands including Piron's and Pete Lala's.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: Who did Herbert Lindsay play with?

Now, Herbert Lindsay, that was a crackerjack violin player. He was one of the best. Now, you call the man's name there. He was one of the best violinists that I would listen to for this particular reason. Herbert Lindsay could make more, yet, listen, yet he's an air player. But he could make more double stops in a manner I renew in my life. See, from anything he played. And catch it right now, solo, classic, or whatever it was. And make all double, fashion, he could make more double stops. And then he ran out of a song. He never played a single string or nothing he played. And do it right now. That Herbert Lindsay was quite an artist. See, even the Peter Ron, even the Peter Buccott. He was better. See, he had more knowledge of the violin. He didn't have as much music as the violin. But he had more knowledge of the violin than what Peter, Peter, Peter, Peter, Peter, Peter, Peter, Peter on either one. See, because it's only knowledge, friend. When you pick that string up and go all over and make all those chords. Even on that you may know music. But now if you can't do that, the father can do that. He's got more knowledge than you got an instrument. See? And Herbert Lindsay, oh, he's a wizard. Played rubber plants. Things like rose leaf frag, maple leaf frag. Frag is electricity. And play them all with double stops. I mean, double stops from the time he started until the end it. Played a lot more double stops than fess over the river. He was a cracker jack. That same Herbert Lindsay was. I died. Is he still alive? I think Herbert is living. I'll try to find that out for you. Herbert Lindsay. I'm sure he's living too because anytime I know Freddie Kepler's brother's living, Louis is living. And Louis, he'll tell me. I'll get in touch with Louis and find out for you.
But where did he play Herbert Lindsay? Did he play along?

No, he played all the bands. All the bands. Every band was downtown. Played in Piron's band. Sometimes Piron didn't have the band. Or sometimes they just changed one man in the band sometimes. Just one man. He said, we come to work like tonight. He said, you're the boss. All of us show up down there, the whole band show up tonight. And the whole band turned around and go back home. They go to Union Harden and New Band right there. But I can't do that today on account of Union. But all of us turned around and go back home. And all of us showed up to come to work. Everyone of us showed up to go back home. But maybe one of the men out of the band would stay at that time. Herbert Lindsay played. He led the band for Pete Lowes. He played there a long time. Frank Early's. You heard talk of Frank Early? He's the one that killed that fella. Buddy Ford sometime ago. That fella called Frank Early. You heard talk of Frank Early, didn't you?
